papers.title: IC-DefectNCD: Image-Intrinsic Priors for Integrated Circuit Defect Detection and Novel Class Discovery via Self-Supervised Learning
papers.summary: Self-Normal/Self-Defect Information Guided two-stage SSL for IC SEM image defect detection + NCD. semi-supervised k-means estimates unknown class count, teacher logits forced to zero on known classes for unlabeled inputs, teacher/student temperature mismatch for cross-view consistency.

papers.title: Breaking the Batch Barrier (B3) of Contrastive Learning via Smart Batch Mining
papers.summary: Teacher model ranks examples + builds similarity graph, community detection identifies strong-negative clusters, batches constructed across clusters. +1.3 / +2.9 points on MMEB, batch size 64 outperforms larger batches.

papers.title: Locality-Sensitive Hashing for Efficient Hard Negative Sampling in Contrastive Learning
papers.summary: Binarize 1024-d float32 embeddings via random orthonormal projection -> Hamming distance for fast hard-neg search. 32x storage reduction, GPU-friendly. Outperforms full-precision cosine on MS MARCO.
papers.patch_candidate: _lsh_hard_neg.py (MoCo queue wrapper); paper code availability not confirmed (fetch partial)

papers.title: Clustering Properties of Self-Supervised Learning (ReSA)
papers.summary: Encoder output has superior clustering vs embeddings/projector. ReSA uses Sinkhorn-Knopp soft assignment on encoder representations -> CE loss across augmented views. Single Sinkhorn execution regardless of aug count.

papers.title: Deep Modularity Networks with Diversity-Preserving Regularization (DMoN-DPR)
papers.summary: 3 reg terms for graph clustering: inter-cluster distance, per-cluster variance, assignment-entropy penalty. Statistical significance on benchmarks.

papers.title: Stable Cluster Discrimination for Deep Clustering (SeCu)
papers.summary: Modifies CE: (1) stop negative-instance gradient on cluster centers, (2) hardness-aware weighting (low pred score -> higher weight), (3) global entropy constraint. Optimal cluster center is weighted average proportional to (1 - p).

papers.title: DECOR: Deep Embedding Clustering with Orientation Robustness (update)
papers.summary: MixedWM38 orientation-invariant manual-tuning-free deep clustering. (already in sota_findings_260516.md #2 — supplementary)
